title: Creators Get Attention, Operators Turn It Into Sales
description:

Creators and marketplace operators serve two very different functions.

The creator generates attention.

The marketplace operator connects that attention to the product, offer and platform so it can become a sale.

Then the content strategist ensures the team is creating the right content, not simply increasing volume.

More content is not the goal. Building a system that turns the right content into revenue is.
